rooms.name: Sanctuary Suite
rooms.note: Larger suite, open views of the landscape

treatments.name: Vaidya consultation
treatments.body: A senior Ayurvedic physician pairs your clinical results with Nadi Pariksha, the traditional pulse reading.

treatments.name: Prakriti assessment
treatments.body: Your constitution (Vata, Pitta, Kapha) is mapped to shape your diet, treatments and daily rhythm.

treatments.name: Panchakarma
treatments.body: The classical five-fold detoxification, prescribed for you and supervised daily. Never a generic programme.

treatments.name: Abhyanga
treatments.body: Daily warm-oil massage performed by two therapists in synchrony.

treatments.name: Shirodhara
treatments.body: A steady stream of warm medicated oil across the forehead, deeply calming to the nervous system.

treatments.name: Sattvic cuisine
treatments.body: Fresh, seasonal meals matched to your dosha, from the sanctuary's own kitchen gardens.
